label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter directly flows through doSomething via assignment to local variable bar, then is returned and written to response.getWriter(). The intermediate HashMap operations are shallow copies that preserve the user-supplied value; there is no sanitization or neutralization applied. The sink writes arbitrary user content as HTML, enabling XSS.
